bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. The track features a high-gain distorted electric guitar playing a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered around a low E pedal tone. A second electric guitar provides harmonized lead lines and sustained power chords. The bass guitar is heavily overdriven, doubling the guitar riff with a metallic clank. The drum kit consists of a punchy kick drum, a dry snare with a sharp crack, and bright hi-hats played with a loose, sloshy texture. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the mid-range bite of the guitars. The arrangement focuses on a repetitive, driving groove with occasional cymbal accents and brief pauses for rhythmic emphasis.

[overdriven bass enters doubling the riff]

[Main Section]
[full drum kit enters with driving kick and snare]

drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A dry, percussive electric guitar plays a syncopated 16th-note rhythmic scratch pattern using muted strums and dominant 9th chords. The bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking with the kick drum on the downbeat and executing rapid octaves and chromatic passing tones. Drums consist of a tight, high-tuned snare with a crisp crack and a dry kick drum. The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features a call-and-response between the guitar's rhythmic stabs and the bass guitar's melodic fills. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the transient peaks of the percussion and string attacks.

[Intro]
[percussive muted guitar strums]
[slap bass enters with syncopated octaves]
[tight snare and dry kick drum enter]

[Main Groove]
[clean electric guitar playing 16th-note funk riffs]
[bass guitar performs melodic pops and slides]
[steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern]

vocals.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A high-gain lead guitar performs rapid alternate picking and melodic shredding. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riffs with a gritty, overdriven tone. Acoustic drums feature a prominent double-kick pedal pattern, a sharp snare, and frequent crash cymbal accents. 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. E minor.
